brief: A wall clock with hands that turn and tell the time.

requirements.evidence: accessory:0#0,0#0 keyhole hanger on piece:0,0,0;full; cover dial with insert hour markers. No clock movement in catalog (find_parts clock/dial=0, find_props clock/hands=0).
prop:1 ruler and prop:2 pencil laid as static hands on cover:0,0,0;full;top. No motor, movement, or rotating part exists in catalog; props cannot rotate or track time.
No timekeeping mechanism, numerals, or movement available; static props only suggest hand positions and do not indicate actual time.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell wall-hangable dial (keyhole hanger, capped cell, cover with insert markers) with ruler and pencil staged as static clock hands. No turning hands or timekeeping is possible with the Hex Cluster catalog: no clock movement, motor, or rotating hands exist, so the time-telling requirements are unmet.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
